# Agent Policy

> Portable policy decisions for agent systems: approvals, permission grants, risk scopes, redaction, retention, waivers, and policy traces.

Site: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/
Repository: https://github.com/limecloud/agentpolicy
Version: v0.1.2

## Start

- What is Agent Policy?: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/what-is-agent-policy
- Specification: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/specification
- Policy model: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/concepts/policy-model
- JSON Schemas: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/reference/json-schemas

## Core contracts

- Policy decision: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/policy-decision
- Risk scope: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/risk-scope
- Approval request: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/approval-request
- Permission grant: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/permission-grant
- Redaction and retention: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/redaction-retention
- Waiver record: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/waiver-record
- Policy trace: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/policy-trace
- Delegation and remote policy: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/delegation-and-remote-policy
- Interoperability: https://limecloud.github.io/agentpolicy/en/contracts/interoperability
